waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: abort-answers-without-record
mutations.why: B answers `aborted` without saving it (handoff.rs:577-578 dropped): A takes the session back and a commit still on the wire lands.

mutations.name: abort-ignores-landed-target
mutations.why: An abort of a `committing` transfer unwinds without looking at the target (resolve skipped): B aborts a session whose journal is already in place.

mutations.name: commit-error-gives-back
mutations.why: A takes the session back on a commit error instead of asking B (session-mutations.ts:311-312 skipped): a duplicate of the commit lands later.
mutations.replace: IF r = "err" THEN (aState' = "reclaimed" /\ aPc' = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED toB)

mutations.name: pending-not-on-disk
mutations.why: begin_handoff keeps the pending entry in memory only: A restarts and runs its copy while B lands it.

mutations.name: commit-ignores-aborted
mutations.why: commit no longer refuses an aborted id (handoff.rs:459 dropped): a commit held past the abort lands.

mutations.name: no-reconcile-on-link-up
mutations.why: Nothing asks B again when its link comes up (index.ts onHostOnline dropped): a transfer left pending stays pending.

mutations.name: resolve-keeps-tombstone
mutations.why: F1 fix removed: resolve (handoff.rs:401-403) marks a landed transfer done without clearing B's old tombstone of the path; after a crash between the rename and the clear nobody runs the session.
mutations.search: ResolveClears == bTomb' = IF ClearOnResolve THEN FALSE ELSE bTomb

mutations.name: no-retry-after-timeout
mutations.why: F2 fix removed: an abort that failed while the link stayed up schedules no retry (session-mutations.ts:245-253); the transfer stays pending until the link drops.
